subject: Platform Growth: proposed consolidation & comms plan
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Platform Growth: proposed consolidation & comms plan

Team —

I wanted to share a concrete proposal for consolidating the Platform Growth squad into a tighter Product + Platform team to reduce duplication and improve our go-to-market velocity. The attached org chart and role-scopes table reflect the recommended moves:

- Merge the Platform Growth ICs into Core Platform (2 ICs move)
- Create a single Product-Platform PM for infra-level prioritization
- Re-scope two senior ICs to staff-level platform engineering (narrower domain)

Rationale:
- Repeated backlog conflicts between Growth and Platform have slowed SLA work and model rollout timelines.
- Consolidation should reduce handoffs, simplify routing for infra requests, and make prioritization clearer for Dedicated/Private customers.

Key asks:
1) Feedback on role scopes and where we should protect career ladders for ICs.
2) Timing for performance-review alignment and any compensation considerations (this quarter vs. next).
3) Review of the attached comms draft — I want a short, candid note for the broader org and a separate script for 1:1s.

Attachments: org-chart_v3.pdf, role-scopes-table.xlsx, comm-draft-platform-growth.docx

Next steps: propose we discuss at Wed leadership sync (10/14). If you can review before EOD Tuesday, I’ll incorporate changes.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform Growth: proposed consolidation & comms plan

Vanessa — thanks for pulling this together. Quick thoughts:

- I support consolidating ownership for infra-related priorities.
- Concern: timing relative to annual performance reviews. If we move folks now, we need clarity on how this affects calibration and promotion timelines. We must avoid creating a perception that moves reset review clocks.

Operational asks:
- Please add a short note outlining how existing OKRs are mapped to the new structure (example mapping would be great).
- For any role that changes scope, include a recommended assessment rubric for expectations over the next 6 months.

Also tagging Marcus / Lauren for feasibility on headcount and reporting implications.

— Markus
Senior VP, Engineering
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform Growth: proposed consolidation & comms plan

Appreciate the draft, Vanessa. A few items from a staffing/ops perspective:

- We should avoid mid-cycle title resets for ICs; re-scope via clear role profiles and personal development plans instead.
- If we move two ICs, we need temporary bandwidth for customer-facing support during the transfer week. Suggest a 2-week overlap and a runbook for handoffs.
- Headcount: consolidation shouldn't increase our committed headcount, but a couple roles may require compensation rebanding; finance should see any uplift.

On comms: Marissa and Lauren, I agree with a short public note + manager script. Keep the public note high-level and optimistic. Manager script should cover the specific impact on individual contributors and any next steps.

— Marcus
VP, Customer Reliability & Ops
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform Growth: proposed consolidation & comms plan

Thanks — I made inline edits to the comm-draft-platform-growth.docx (Drive link in related_links). High-level suggestions:

- Public send: 5–6 sentences, emphasize continuity for customers, highlight opportunity for clearer ownership on infra SLAs.
- Manager script: sample 1:1 prompts to address career concerns, and a short FAQ (Will my title change? How will compensation be handled? Who do I go to with questions?).
- Internal manager prep session: recommend a 30-min rehearsal 24 hours before the announcement so managers can practice the script and expected answers.

Also, recommend we coordinate with Talent Ops; looping Sarah at Acme HR for early input on severance/comp considerations.

— Marissa
Head of Product Marketing, Developer Experience
From: Sarah Henson <sarah@acme-hr.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform Growth: proposed consolidation & comms plan

Vanessa/Team —

Saw the thread after Marissa looped me in. A couple compliance/removal items to flag from the vendor/contract side (we do HR support for a partner company):

- If any role changes reduce hours or change employment status, ensure we have written agreements and 30-day notice to remain compliant with regional labor rules.
- Severance: standard guideline we use is 1 week per year of service for role eliminations; discretionary cases require sign-off from legal.
- Performance review timing: moving someone during a calibration window is tricky. If you must move now, include a paragraph in the manager script that preserves the review period and explains changes will be considered at the next calibration.

Happy to jump on a quick call Wednesday afternoon to review scripts and severance language.

— Sarah Henson
Senior HR Consultant, Acme HR (vendor)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Henson <sarah@acme-hr.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Platform Growth: proposed consolidation & comms plan

Great feedback — thank you. Plan to action: 

1) I will update the org-chart and add a 1:1 FAQ and manager script with the language Sarah suggested preserving review windows.
2) Marcus: I’ll add an OKR mapping table and a 6-month assessment rubric for re-scoped roles; I’ll share before the leadership sync on Friday.
3) Marissa: please lead the manager rehearsal session — propose Thu 10/15 10:00am PT.
4) Markus: if you can confirm there are no promotion timelines impacted for the two ICs, we’ll keep calibration intact; otherwise, we’ll delay public comms until after the review cycle.

Meeting: I’ve booked a 30-min pre-announce sync Fri 10/15 11:00 AM PT (invite sent). If anyone needs to change time, ping me.

Attachment: updated_org-chart_v3.pdf (see Drive link)

Thanks all — I’ll circulate the final comms and the runbook after the rehearsal.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
